Intake note - Commercial team
Date: 9 August 2022
Client: Bhavana Bhandari, a 48-year-old fashion designer from Vadodara.
Address: Plot 10, Fatehgunj, Vadodara 390056
Phone: +91 79226 68456. Email: bhavana.bhandari@example.com. PAN EXZPB6843R.
Matter: cheque bounce
Opposing party: Karve Textiles Pvt Ltd
Facts: A cheque for INR 12,50,000/- issued by Karve Textiles Pvt Ltd bounced: the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match.
The matter was filed as CC/2441/2022 before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Vadodara on 29/09/2022.
